invariants: every symbol has a non-empty name
every owner is global or another symbol in the same file
every contains edge names a symbol in the same file
no symbol is a member of itself

disclosureSample.ownerFromParameter: deps/codec.lua :: pause claims owner "emitter", which is not declared in this file
disclosureSample.containsSourceFromParameter: deps/codec.lua :: contains emitter -> pause where emitter is not declared in this file
disclosureSample.selfOwned: examples/app/libs/stack.lua :: stack is owned by itself (a method sharing its container's name)
